purpose: Initial-state diagnosis only; no propagation, parameter fitting, or scattering modification
workload_policy: Fixed 8192/4096/4096 accepted draws set before inspecting any energies, reduced from a planned 20000 per case due to CPU contention. Same initial RNG IDs deterministically replay the aborted preliminary sampling prefix.
independence: SEM is over independent trajectory RNG streams, never over beads

definitions.BC_rest_frame: Remove beadwise BC coordinate and momentum COM; equal hydrogen masses. This exactly removes the launch velocity and translation.
definitions.kinetic_bc: mean_beads sum_BC |p_i|^2/(2m_i); fictitious ring momentum kinetic energy
definitions.primitive_bc_bkmp2: K_BC + mean_beads V_BKMP2(isolated BC, spectator at lab z=-99 bohr) - Vmin - spring_BC
definitions.centroid_bc_energy_bkmp2: centroid BC internal kinetic + V_BKMP2(BC centroid geometry, 99-bohr spectator)-Vmin
definitions.switch_potential_delta: mean_beads V_BKMP2(isolated BC)-Vmin - mean_beads V_harmonic; paired sample difference relative to the same minimum
definitions.launch_residual_interaction: mean_beads V_BKMP2(actual launched system) - mean_beads V_BKMP2(isolated BC)
definitions.variance_reduced_mean: Exact conditional harmonic expectation plus measured paired V_BKMP2-V_harm; unbiased control variate with coefficient 1 for this linear diatom ensemble
definitions.warning: Primitive estimators can be negative and very broad. Their per-sample distribution is not a microcanonical physical-energy distribution. Conditioning changes the expected initial energy.

paper_figure2.quantum_reference_description: Dashed reference lines slightly below harmonic ground level and near 6340 cm^-1 for v1; exact plotted means not digitized.
paper_figure2.scope: Figure averages 50000 initial configurations during propagation on full PES; current audit is t=0 only and mostly different beta.

analytic_expectations.conditional_formula: Gaussian centroid Q/P plus random-phase kick; exact two-sided bond-norm cutoff, phase quadrature with 16384 equal bins; internal ring modes remain unconditional
